slides.title: Buying near Laval's rivers? 5 flood checks
slides.sub: Looking along the Rivière des Mille Îles or Rivière des Prairies? Start here.

photo.credit: Rivière des Mille Îles, Laval · Photo: P199, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Look up the address on Québec's map

photo.credit: Rivière des Mille Îles, Sainte-Rose · Photo: Jeangagnon, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Type the address or lot number into Québec's **interactive flood map**. It takes two minutes.

slides.title: The flood rules changed this year
slides.body: Québec's new flood-zone rules replaced the old transitional regime. New maps will replace ones mostly **30+ years old**.

slides.title: Remember spring 2019 in Laval
slides.body: Evacuation was recommended for about **400 addresses** in Îles-Laval. Ask about any riverside street's flood history.

slides.title: Read the seller's declarations
slides.body: OACIQ guidance lists these flood questions. If there was damage, ask for invoices, permits and a **full inspection**.

slides.title: Call your insurer before you offer

photo.credit: Rivière des Prairies, facing Saint-Vincent-de-Paul · Photo: Jeangagnon, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Overland flood and sewer backup coverage are **optional add-ons**. Get a quote for the exact address first.
slides.source: Per Insurance Bureau of Canada, November 2026
